stem: Which line of dialogue from Scene 1 shows that Caitlin thinks Horatio’s treatment of the sourdough starter is exaggerated?

options.label: A
options.text: CAITLIN: [She throws her hands up.] A terrarium? I give up. What is your big new project? You said you had to feed it, so I’m completely stumped. (line 3)

options.label: B
options.text: CAITLIN: Is this another volcano? Don’t you remember when your volcano for the science fair erupted all over the carpet after you fed it all that baking soda? (line 6)

options.label: C
options.text: CAITLIN: Why do you want to make bread from something that old? And what does a dough ball eat? (line 12)

options.label: D
options.text: CAITLIN: OK, but I’m still not sure what the big deal is. It’s just dough. (line 14)
